question: How do great souls enter the airy world?
premises: Having meditated or abandoned breaths, they make holding there.
inference: Meditative breath-control and holding allow great souls to enter the airy realm.
uncertainties: Whether tyaktvātha and dhyātvā are alternatives.
plain_english: Having meditated or abandoned breaths and made holding there, great souls enter that, becoming air and sky-bodied.
